archetypes.name: dyn-agent-lint-fail-closed
archetypes.rationale: New independent v2 check must not be skipped by v1 early returns or shared suppressions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect lint_agent_tool_contract.scan_file for independent v1 and v2 finding accumulation. Confirm tools:[Read] still emits v2 findings, each suppression pragma scopes to one check, and Finding.message is printed per finding. Review the new pytest cases for mandate, fail-closed, Read independence, and suppression isolation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
